correctness.rationale: For radii (1,7/5,1,7/5,1), four exact-rational sign-change certificates produce fourteen interior critical configurations with explicit sign-pattern multiplicities; six more occur at lambda=1. The Hessian is definite for the all-equal-sign families, nonsingular by explicit eigenvalue inequalities for the all-four-opposite family, nonsingular by the reciprocal-sine determinant criterion for the 3-to-1 family, and diagonal nonsingular at the six endpoint configurations. Thus at least twenty distinct nondegenerate critical points exist.
